data.one_liner: Write and debug Flutter tests with action history, time travel, screenshots, and video records.
data.what_it_does: A testing framework for Flutter that provides full action history, time travel with screenshots, video recordings, and retryability. It also allows running tests on host computers for faster execution and includes enhanced golden testing capabilities.
use_when: You want to easily debug flaky or failing Flutter integration tests with rich error info and video records.
You need faster execution of tests by running them directly on your host computer.
You require advanced golden testing with tolerances and cropping.
avoid_when: You are looking for a simple unit-testing mock library without integration or GUI test runner requirements.
strengths: Full action history and time travel with screenshots and video records.
Fast execution on host computers without changing test code.
Automatic retryability and isolation mode between tests.
weaknesses: Documentation can be incomplete or require looking into issues.
Setup includes running a separate manager application/process alongside worker apps.
data.setup_notes: Requires running a separate manager app/process alongside your worker app with specific VM service port arguments.

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard Dart core unit and widget testing without a custom UI manager or video recording tools.
